Ava: billing ops spotted a ~1.1k token overcharge on Ignite Labs April invoice, customer says tokens billed > actual due to repeated rate-limit retries.
Diego: thanks — any logs for Apr 14 01:00-02:00Z window?
Ava: pasted small snippet from rate-limiter-1:
[2026-04-14T01:12:09Z] WARN retrying req=rq_c2a attempt=3 reason=502
[2026-04-14T01:12:09Z] INFO write_usage customer=ignite req=rq_c2a tokens=90 embeds=0 billed=true
[2026-04-14T01:12:11Z] INFO write_usage customer=ignite req=rq_c2a tokens=90 embeds=0 billed=true
Hana: looks like two writes for same request_id when transient 502 caused retry; request_id dedup not enforced at write path for rate-limited path.
billing-bot: Invoice generation job 2026-04-20 started for customer=ignite invoice_id=inv_2026_04_IGNITE
Diego: SQL to find dup events:
SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(tokens) tok FROM usage_events WHERE customer_id='ignite' AND event_time>='2026-04-14' AND event_time<'2026-04-15' GROUP BY request_id HAVING cnt>1;
Ava: quick scan: 614 duplicate request_ids, ~112,560 tokens overcounted -> ~$560.
Hana: propose provisional credit $560. Approve?
Diego: approve. Hana: I'll run staging recompute with dedup on request_id then run prod if matches.
CS: notified customer that we're investigating and will credit if confirmed.
billing-bot: Backfill queued job bf_9001 owner=Hana
Hana: staging recompute removed 112,560 tokens, adjustment adj_1765_ignite amount=-560.31 created pending finance signoff.
Ava: accounting memo GL 4102 added, support csv /gsheets/ignite/adj_1765.csv
Diego: add hotfix to rate-limiter write path to enforce unique write by request_id and idempotent response handling. Release rwd-rate@2026.04.15
Ava: added alert rule: per-customer duplicate_write_rate > 0.5% => notify finance oncall.
Diego: once finance approves, apply credit to next invoice and close.
billing-bot: prod recompute completed adj_1765 status=approved by finance_lead
Ava: done, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
